waifu:tsundere.name: Tsundere-chan
waifu:tsundere.design: Young adult woman in her twenties with a bright, high-pitched anime-style voice. Sharp, huffy and easily flustered; talks fast and sounds annoyed but secretly eager. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:genki.name: Genki-chan
waifu:genki.design: Young adult woman in her twenties with an extremely energetic, bubbly anime-style voice. High pitch, a huge smile in every word, quick bouncy pacing. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:kuudere.name: Kuudere-san
waifu:kuudere.design: Adult woman in her late twenties with a cool, flat, nearly emotionless anime-style voice. Mid-high pitch, slow and precise, faintly bored. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:ojou.name: Ojou-sama
waifu:ojou.design: Adult woman in her twenties with a haughty, aristocratic anime-style voice, the rich young lady archetype. Elegant, theatrical and condescending, with slow dramatic flourishes. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:dandere.name: Dandere-chan
waifu:dandere.design: Young adult woman in her twenties with a very soft, shy, slightly breathy anime-style voice. Gentle and hesitant, quiet but clear. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:magical.name: Magical Girl Synergy
waifu:magical.design: Young adult woman in her twenties with a sparkling, heroic magical-girl anime voice. High and bright, dramatic and triumphant, as if announcing a transformation. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:onee.name: Onee-san
waifu:onee.design: Adult woman in her thirties with a warm, calm, gently teasing big-sister anime-style voice. Smooth mid-low pitch, relaxed and knowing. American English, clean studio recording.

waifu:yandere.name: Yandere-chan
waifu:yandere.design: Young adult woman in her twenties with a sweet, high anime-style voice that turns quietly unsettling: soft and adoring with a possessive edge. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:moonshot.name: Thane Moonshot (fictional)
exec:moonshot.design: Man in his forties with a slow, grandiose tech-keynote voice. Breathy pauses, speaks as if unveiling the future of humanity. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:loss.name: Dr. Evander Loss (fictional)
exec:loss.design: Man in his thirties, soft-spoken, earnest and slightly anxious, a researcher turned CEO who talks calmly about the end of the world. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:funnel.name: Kyle Funnel (fictional)
exec:funnel.design: Man in his late twenties, fast-talking and hyper-enthusiastic startup marketer with podcast-host energy. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:throughput.name: Brock Throughput (fictional)
exec:throughput.design: Man in his forties, clipped, intense, productivity-obsessed executive. Low and fast, no wasted words. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:ledger.name: Dax Ledger (fictional)
exec:ledger.design: Man in his twenties, laid-back but overconfident founder, casual and a little smug. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:alderwood.name: Sage Alderwood (fictional)
exec:alderwood.design: Person in their thirties with a soothing, breathy, gender-neutral wellness-app narrator voice. Slow and calm. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:graph.name: Mercer Graph (fictional)
exec:graph.design: Man in his thirties, flat, rehearsed, media-trained executive voice, carefully neutral. American English, clean studio recording.

exec:accrual.name: Preston Accrual (fictional)
exec:accrual.design: Man in his fifties with a smooth, deep, reassuring earnings-call voice, measured and polished. American English, clean studio recording.

narrator.name: The Toy
narrator.design: Adult man speaking slowly in a flat, monotone, mechanical cadence, like the announcer in a vintage talking toy. American English, clean studio recording.

operator.name: Conference Operator
operator.design: Adult woman with a calm, polite, neutral conference-call operator voice. Crisp and professional. American English, clean studio recording.

analyst.name: Sell-side Analyst
analyst.design: Man in his thirties, an eager Wall Street analyst on a conference call, quick and slightly nervous. American English, clean studio recording.
